content.text:
The robot found the red ball, walked up to it and is now resting in a crouch.

Before I called rest, the bottom camera showed the ball about 20–30 cm ahead and slightly left of the robot's feet. The robot was facing it. I didn't check the ball again after rest.

The last image, taken as the robot crouched, shows a person's hand with a tape measure reaching into view. Someone in the room appears to be measuring the distance.
